analyst_view.overall: Early view: Granada, under Pacheta, have won five league games in a row with a direct game built on crosses and set pieces, but two reports say Owen Emeka will miss about a month at the Under-17 World Cup, and José Arnáiz, Baila Diallo and Pau Casadesús were injured before their home game with Las Palmas on Sunday. Sabadell play at Eldense first with eight players out, several of them long-term (Gioacchini, Pipa, Miki Codina, Nuamah); Urri's ban will be served by then.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.1 goals. I have moved from same to lower: Sabadell's injury list has taken away much of their attack, and Granada have five clean sheets this season and now lose Emeka, one of their scorers in recent weeks.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners. I have moved from higher to same: LaLiga's figures show Sabadell are not really a possession side, and Granada's crossing game earns its own corners, so the two effects roughly balance.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.4 cards. I have changed from lower to higher: LaLiga has Sabadell committing far more fouls than they receive, and a depleted home side facing a direct, physical Granada team should give the referee plenty to do.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.3 shots, with 17.5 for Sabadell. I have moved from same to lower: Sabadell average around ten shots a game by LaLiga's count, and that was before they lost so many players.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.8 shots on target. I lean slightly lower with the shots, since Sabadell lose their joint top scorer Gioacchini and Granada take few but clean chances.
